messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **statutory holidays that create “long weekends”** in Canada for the year 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day weekend without needing to take an extra day off.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Provinces/Regions that observe it | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-----------------------------------|-------|
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 | Monday | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario (except Toronto), New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Prince Edward Island | Creates a 3‑day weekend in those provinces. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Friday | All provinces & territories | 3‑day weekend nationwide. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | All provinces & territories | 3‑day weekend nationwide. |
| **Civic Holiday** | Aug 7 | Monday | Most provinces (Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan) – *not* observed in Quebec, Nunavut, Northwest Territories, Yukon | 3‑day weekend in those provinces. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Monday | All provinces & territories | 3‑day weekend nationwide. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Monday | All provinces & territories | 3‑day weekend nationwide. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 | Monday | All provinces & territories | 3‑day weekend nationwide. |

### Quick Summary

| Long Weekend | Dates (2023) | Provinces Covered |
|--------------|--------------|-------------------|
| **Family Day** | Feb 18–20 | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario (except Toronto), New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, PEI |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 5–7 | All |
| **Victoria Day** | May 20–22 | All |
| **Civic Holiday** | Aug 5–7 | Most provinces (except Quebec, Nunavut, NWT, Yukon) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 2–4 | All |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 7–9 | All |
| **Christmas** | Dec 23–25 | All |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you want to support *province‑specific* long weekends, store the holiday dates per province.  
> - For holidays that fall on a Sunday (e.g., New Year’s Day, Canada Day, Remembrance Day, Boxing Day), Canada usually observes a substitute day (the following Monday). Those are **not** long weekends unless the substitute day itself creates a 3‑day stretch.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of all statutory holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or if you need the data in a particular format (JSON, CSV, etc.).

- Good Friday – Apr 7 (Friday) – long weekend.
- Victoria Day – May 22 (Monday) – long weekend.
- Canada Day – Jul 1 (Saturday) – not long weekend.
- Civic Holiday – Aug 7 (Monday) – long weekend in many provinces.
- Labour Day – Sep 4 (Monday) – long weekend.
- Thanksgiving – Oct 9 (Monday) – long weekend.
- Remembrance Day – Nov 11 (Saturday) – not long weekend.
- Christmas Day – Dec 25 (Monday) – long weekend.
- Boxing Day – Dec 26 (Tuesday) – not long weekend.
